subject: MAP: POC environment preflight & owners for network / auth dependencies
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@brightarc.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 08 Dec 2026 13:05:00 -0500
Subject: MAP: POC environment preflight & owners for network / auth dependencies

Hi Samira —

Thanks again for the call earlier. Per our discussion, I’m sending a concise preflight for the MAP milestone that covers the POC environment dependencies we need to validate before we can schedule the technical kickoff. I attached a one-page MAP draft (v1) and a quick network diagram.

High-level dependencies (POC environment):
- VPC peering / private connectivity: BrightArc VPC <> Redwood POC VPC (bidirectional routing, no transitive rules)
- IP allowlists: outbound IPs for telemetry and inbound API callbacks (we’ll provide EIP list)
- SSO / SAML: tenant config + test user; metadata exchange and IdP contact
- Secrets / KMS: approach for storing model keys and API secrets (bring-your-own KMS or Redwood-managed)

Owners & ask: please confirm the owner and target date for each dependency below. If you prefer, reply inline.
1) VPC peering: owner at BrightArc + earliest OK to start peering (we recommend a 2-3 hour maintenance window for routing checks)
2) IP allowlist: owner + contact for firewall request + any procurement/approval steps
3) SSO / SAML: IdP owner + sample SAML metadata (or IdP URL) we can use to pre-configure
4) Secrets/KMS: security owner + whether BrightArc wants to use their KMS or Redwood’s managed key rotations

Target MAP milestone: POC environment ready for smoke tests by 2027-01-12 (suggested). If any of the above have longer lead times, call them out and we’ll adjust the MAP dates.

Next steps I can own from our side:
- Aditya will produce the exact CIDR/IP list and a peering template by EOD tomorrow.
- Camila will coordinate the SAML test flow and share the stub app for validation.

Attachments: MAP-draft-v1.pdf (one-page milestone table), network-diagram.png, brightarc-network-cidr.csv (placeholder for your firewall team)

If you’d like a quick 30-min follow-up with your network/security leads tomorrow, propose a time and we’ll join.

Thanks —
Tessa Morgan
Sr. Account Exec | Redwood Inference
T: +1 415-555-0123
https://www.redwoodinference.com

From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@brightarc.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: BrightArc IT <it@brightarc.com>, procurement@brightarc.com
Date: Tue, 08 Dec 2026 15:22:00 -0500
Subject: Re: MAP: POC environment preflight & owners for network / auth dependencies

Tessa —

Appreciate the clear summary and attachments. Quick answers inline below, owners are included on the cc so they have visibility.

1) VPC peering
- Owner: Miguel Ortega (cc’d via BrightArc IT)
- Earliest window: week of 2026-12-20; Miguel indicates scheduling can begin once we share the peering config.

2) IP allowlist
- Owner: Network Security Team (it@brightarc.com)
- Firewall change request: procurement will need the formal change ticket (procurement@brightarc.com) — ETA 3 business days once we receive the CSV with explicit IPs.

3) SSO / SAML
- Owner: Anne Li (Identity team) — she prefers we exchange metadata.xml and a test user. I’ll ask Anne to share the IdP metadata by EOD Thursday.

4) Secrets / KMS
- Owner: Security Ops (it@brightarc.com)
- BrightArc prefers BYOK (our KMS). We’ll need a short KMS integration spec from your side (key usage, rotation policy).

Target dates: we can target an internal readiness gate by 2027-01-10 but peering scheduling pushes final verification into the week of 2026-12-27 — that’s workable for the POC start in early Jan.

I’ve attached the current CIDR blocks we use to avoid overlap. Miguel / Anne — can you follow up with approximate availability for a 30-min alignment call before 12/20?

Thanks,
Samira Khan
Head of Platform Partnerships | BrightArc
samira.khan@brightarc.com

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 09 Dec 2026 08:17:00 -0500
Subject: Re: MAP: POC environment preflight & owners for network / auth dependencies

Samira / team —

Following up with the technical details you asked for. I put the initial CIDR/IP list into the attached CSV (brightarc-network-cidr.csv) — please confirm that these don’t overlap with your private ranges:
- Redwood POC VPC: 10.210.0.0/16
- Suggested peering subnet (no overlap required): 10.211.0.0/16
- Egress public IPs (for allowlist): 34.103.12.45, 34.103.12.46, 34.103.12.47

Peering notes / checklist:
- Exchange VPC IDs, account IDs, and desired route table changes.
- Ensure no overlapping CIDR and remove any restrictive egress rules that block 443 to our telemetry endpoints.
- We recommend enabling VPC flow logs during validation to speed troubleshooting (we can share IAM role for logs ingestion).

SSO / SAML test plan (Camila will lead):
- Exchange IdP metadata.xml → Redwood config → create test user on both sides → smoke login test (SAML response validation).

KMS: we’ll send a short BYOK spec (key usage + access pattern) by EOD; if BrightArc prefers Redwood-managed keys, we can outline tradeoffs.

I can be available for a technical alignment call on 2026-12-16 between 09:00–12:00 PT.

Cheers,
Aditya Rao
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Date: Wed, 09 Dec 2026 09:42:00 -0500
Subject: Re: MAP: POC environment preflight & owners for network / auth dependencies

Samira / Miguel / Anne —

Thanks for the quick turn. That timeline looks reasonable. Confirming next steps and owners for the MAP milestone: 

- VPC peering (owner: Miguel Ortega / BrightArc IT) — action: exchange VPC IDs and schedule peering (target: schedule week of 12/20).
- IP allowlist (owner: BrightArc Network Security) — action: procurement to open firewall change once they receive CSV (target: 3 business days after CSV).
- SSO / SAML (owner: Anne Li / Identity) — action: exchange metadata + execute smoke login test (target: metadata by 12/10, test by 12/17).
- KMS (owner: Security Ops) — action: review BYOK spec from Redwood (we’ll provide spec by 12/09).

We’ll update the MAP-draft-v1.pdf with these owners and the proposed dates and re-share. Camila / Aditya will lead the technical prep from Redwood’s side; I’ll coordinate the overall MAP and target close for the POC environment readiness gate: 2027-01-10 (soft target).

Confirming a tech alignment call: Samira suggested availability and Aditya offered 12/16 09:00–12:00 PT. Miguel / Anne — if you can pick a 30-min slot in that window we’ll send a calendar invite.

If anything changes on procurement lead times or approvals, flag it here and we’ll update the MAP dates.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Sr. Account Exec | Redwood Inference
